items.title: Vår Energi (OB:VAR) Agreed A $4.4 Billion North Sea Asset Deal
items.summary: Vår Energi (OB:VAR) has agreed a $4.4b acquisition of ConocoPhillips’ Norwegian and UK assets, reshaping its North Sea footprint. The purchase adds a broad portfolio of producing fields and infrastructure in Norway and the UK to Vår Energi’s asset base. Completion of the transaction would position Vår Energi as Europe’s largest independent exploration and production company by scale. items.title: Why Is ConocoPhillips (COP) Leaving Norway After More Than 50 Years?
items.summary: ConocoPhillips (NYSE:COP) has agreed to sell its entire Norwegian upstream business, exiting the Norwegian continental shelf after more than 50 years. The transaction transfers ConocoPhillips' Norwegian upstream assets to Vår Energi, shifting ownership of a long held North Sea portfolio. Management has linked the planned exit to future use of sale proceeds for corporate purposes and share repurchases.
